message.content: {"version": "1", "text": "Your outfit for the office day blends a relaxed yet polished look: the chunky knitted sweater in deep olive khaki gives you warmth and comfort, layered under the sleek black button vest that adds structure without adding bulk. The tailored black cropped trousers offer clean lines to balance the softer knitwear, while the glossy black pumps with delicate toe ties add an elegant touch suitable for your workplace environment. A rich brown leather crossbody bag grounds the look with its sophisticated silhouette, providing both style and practicality. This ensemble works beautifully as it combines comfort and sophistication — perfect for navigating long days in the office without compromising on style.", "how_to_wear": ["Layer the sweater under the vest to keep your arms free for note-taking while maintaining a polished appearance throughout meetings.", "Tuck the vest slightly at the front if you wish to create subtle definition without marking your waist directly.", "Carry the bag crossbody or in hand depending on how formal your meetings are that day."], "wrong_photos": [], "swap": {"item": null, "why": null, "to": null}, "named": [{"n": "#148·32", "what": "the chunky knitted sweater"}, {"n": "#449·32", "what": "the black button vest"}, {"n": "#241·06", "what": "the glossy black pumps with toe ties"}, {"n": "#257·21", "what": "the brown leather crossbody bag"}, {"n": "#144·22", "what": "the tailored black cropped trousers"}], "about_items": [{"n": "#148·32", "text": "A relaxed-fit, chunky knitted sweater in deep olive khaki with a soft white ribbed collar that frames your neck gently and adds subtle contrast against darker tones."}, {"n": "#449·32", "text": "A structured black sleeveless vest with wooden buttons running down the front — it sits lightly over the sweater without adding volume, offering clean vertical lines."}, {"n": "#241·06", "text": "Glossy black dress shoes with a slim stiletto heel and elegant toe ties that add delicate femininity to your workday steps."}, {"n": "#257·21", "text": "A rich brown leather crossbody bag with a sculptural rounded top handle — its smooth texture complements the matte knits while adding warmth to your palette."}, {"n": "#144·22", "text": "Tailored black cropped trousers with a high waist and tapered legs that elongate your silhouette, ending just above the ankle for easy movement during daily routines."}]}
